# Three.js 0.180.0

Unmodified `three.module.min.js` and `three.core.min.js` from the official npm
`three` package at version 0.180.0, vendored for offline runtime use. MIT license
included in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
Runtime docs: https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html
